answer.answer: The median concentration rose by a factor of about 93.7 (from 0.00214 to 0.200429 pieces/m3), but this comes from only 3 studies in 2000-2004 versus 17 in 2020-2024 with no overlapping studies, so the change reflects shifts in which locations/methods were sampled rather than a proven real-world increase in ocean microplastic levels.
